diagnostics.notes: Elevation crossings refined by bisection; peaks by golden-section search. Half-open search interval [start, end). Below-threshold brackets are certified by a first-order elevation-rate bound and a second-order curvature bound using the analytic endpoint rates; brackets that cannot be proven are subdivided down to the 1e-7 s time / 1e-6 deg elevation numerical resolution, and anything still unprovable is listed in uncovered_intervals rather than assumed clear.
